concerns.text: The validation targets (dipole moment, isotropic polarizability, HOMO‑LUMO gap) are computed by the same DFT calculations that generate the IR spectra used as predictors. Because both predictor and outcome are deterministic outputs of the same underlying quantum‑chemical method, the evaluation is circular: the model is essentially learning to reproduce a quantity that is not independent of the input, making the scientific claim that spectra “predict” these properties trivial by definition rather than an empirical discovery.
